slice: US long rates hit a 24-year high, AI fakes outrun the facts, 3,000 jobs land in Hyderabad.

callouts.text: new jobs in India over two years as DoorDash opens a global tech hub in Hyderabad.
30-year US Treasury yield on Tuesday, the highest since June 2002.

stories.title: DoorDash to create 3,000 jobs in Hyderabad
points: Opened a Hyderabad tech hub on Wednesday.
Starts with 500 roles in customer support and admin.
stories.why: AI job fears aside, real hiring lands here.
stories.other: Support work automates easily; jobs may move.

stories.title: Fiscal deficit hits 41.9% of FY27 target
points: Gap of ₹7.10 lakh crore in April–August; 38.1% a year ago.
Capex at ₹5.10 lakh crore, 41.7% of the year’s budget.
stories.other: Five months is early; much of it is capex.

stories.title: Chandra’s family firm lands 2nd TVS deal
points: Hanno One plans a ₹330-cr park in Karnataka for TVS Motor.
TVS’s Venu Srinivasan backed Chandra; the board wasn’t told.
stories.why: Disclosure is the bedrock of trust at Tata.
stories.other: Tata Sons says it didn’t need a board nod.

stories.title: Punjab campuses burn on WhatsApp rumours
points: Chitkara: a hostel prank became tales of dead girls, a ghost.
LPU: NH-44 blocked over unverified claim; FIR, SIT set up.
stories.why: Soon AI will fake the ‘ghost video’ too.
stories.other: Distrust, not just rumour, may fuel the anger.

stories.title: US 30-year yield hits highest since 2002
points: 10-year yield at 5.29%, highest since 2007.
Oil above $100 and Fed hike bets drive the sell-off.
stories.why: Long rates set the price of every loan.
stories.other: Stocks near highs; cooler oil could ease it.

stories.title: KKR warns of AI borrowing risk in credit
points: AI debt is ~$600bn, 6.3% of US high-grade bonds.
Nearly $8tn of AI build-out is planned by 2030.
stories.why: AI risk now sits in ‘safe’ bond portfolios.
stories.other: Priced in? Spreads may already reflect it.

stories.title: Santa Ana’s ‘viper’ was an AI hoax
points: A resident showed police an AI-made photo of a Gaboon viper.
Police’s Grok check called it real; no snake was found.
stories.why: A fake takes one prompt; expect many more.
stories.other: Hoaxes predate AI; human checks still work.

stories.title: America.gov: AI chatbots at the front door
points: Gemini and Grok answer from 29,000 government websites.
Passports and name changes are listed as coming in 2027.
stories.why: Rough start, right idea; India has UMANG.
stories.other: Chatbot errors on benefits could cost dearly.

stories.title: Americans back populist price caps
points: 87% back capping drug prices; 79% a 10% card-rate cap.
14 of 16 cost-of-living ideas won majority support.
stories.other: Would support hold if costs were spelled out?

stories.title: Burnham: rejoining the EU is an option
points: Andy Burnham says Brexit has done more harm than good.
Options: status quo, customs union, single market, rejoin.
stories.why: Ten years on, Brexit is back on the table.
stories.other: Critics fear old wounds; EU may not say yes.
